Dunlin is meaningfully stronger on quantitative reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.9, GPQA 64.1 vs 56.2) and at least ties on creative generation. Willet additionally self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work with high task latitude, while Dunlin's preferences are flat — so Dunlin is both the more capable and better-suited choice here.
